The OpenMP static row loop covers [0,dim), and each row traverses its full half-open CSR interval, gathers vec[cols[j]], accumulates products, and writes out[i]. Native host control retains the repeated worker dispatch and the compiled worker retains its row/nonzero loop backedges.

source_evidence.claim: Parsing -i assigns iterations; after the timer starts, the outer loop invokes spmvCpu until iter reaches iterations.
The OpenMP static worksharing loop spans all rows [0,dim); for each row, the inner loop visits every j in its CSR delimiter interval, loads col/value/vector, accumulates, and stores the row output.

compiled_evidence.claim: The timed native control initializes an iteration counter, calls the outlined OpenMP SpMV worker, increments and compares the counter, and branches back to the worker call until the requested repetitions finish.
